reason: The day filter at packages/lib/slots.ts:206-208 still compares the fake-UTC `override.start` (organizer wall-clock built with `dayjs.utc(override.date).hour(...)` in packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:221) as a real instant against `startOfInviteeDay`. The patch's invitee-minus-organizer offset is applied only to hour/minute at slots.ts:212-223, which wraps past midnight and drops the day shift, so the override attaches to the wrong invitee day (e.g. a New York 09:00–17:00 override seen from Tokyo becomes 23:00–07:00 on day D and is skipped as start >= end at slots.ts:68).
